name: MediaPlus
description: One page item that records audio and video and takes photos, on phones and desktops: record, pause, resume, review, record again; size and length limits with an early warning and an automatic stop; a photo editor with crop (free or fixed shapes), rotate, flip, brightness, contrast, colour, black and white, drawing and resize; MP4 / M4A that play and seek in every player; live transcription in English or Arabic, or your own speech service; drafts that survive a reload; everything kept in an APEX collection until your page saves it into your own table. No database objects needed.
